recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a work group opens a new issue for broader medication safety checklist guidance.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification MedicationStatement issue asking to clarify that when periodMax is specified, period is the lower bound/minimum interval between each time a medication is given or taken; final Jira comments say the sentence was added to Period and equivalent elements and that the safety page was not changed.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly names FHIR-14231. The relevant text appears to have been applied via commit 3c90bd518312a0c35842ca968584ee9d017dba8c for FHIR-16986/svn r14076, which added the exact periodMax lower-bound sentence to Timing.repeat.period and parallel Timing range clarifications before FHIR-14231 was called done.
additional_context: FHIR-13384 was the original same request and was resolved No Change after explaining that period is already periodMin when periodMax is present. FHIR-16986 is the broader Published Timing range clarification whose implementation supplied this wording. source/fhir.ini keeps Timing, Dosage, DosageDetails, and MedicationStatement in the current build scope, and MedicationStatement.dosage is a DosageDetails element using the shared Dosage/Timing path. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because source/datatypes/timing.xml already states that if periodMax is present, Timing.repeat.period indicates the lower bound of the allowed range of the period length. Adding safety checklist text would conflict with the final Jira comment that MnM agreed not to add it.
